core_outputs.description: FRDILightDrvMdl stops driving right front turn signal output (DILamp_RH_HSD)
FRDILightDrvMdl continuously sends DirectionLightControl.DirectionLightSta == 0 (Off) InstanceID=2 to [DILightCtrlMdl], at least three frames.

engineering_interpretation: This table specifies the logic for controlling the right front turn signal lamp based on commands from the Direction Light Control Module. It defines when the lamp should be turned off (via FRDILightDrvMdl) and under what conditions this action is triggered or exited.
